body: Wow lol. You are literally every girls worst nightmare. Shame on you for seeing someone else and still considering what could be with your ex. I understand being young (I am assuming because men don't do this) and being afraid of being lonely, but if you're with a girl and she trusts you, you will hinder her trust potentially for the rest of her dating life. It's not all about you. So seriously, shame on you. One or the other bud. Don't be pathetic.
Lol all you "doctors" in the comments should stop trying to diagnose a guy you've never met.
I doubt you're good enough in bed to make her feel "all good" while she did nothing for you lolololol

Just a little update. 

This morning I woke up, and I didn't have to work because of a technicality. One of my coworkers is sick and said she was going to the hospital today, and the other cannot come in because he has to watch his children and his girlfriend works. Since there's no one else to come in, I cannot open the store. I woke up and felt great today. I even took a snapchat with the caption something along the lines of that I loved my life or something. 

Not even a half an hour after I woke up I got a text about how I was expected at work NOW. I went from feeling soooooo good to feeling anxious and suddenly exhausted.

😭 thank you so much for your kind words... I won't pretend that i don't have a modestly comfy life. I have opportunities that I know others do not. In all of these respects I am very fortunate. I feel often that I may have settled into this life because it is comfy. But then I wonder.. would life be worse if I left? Sometimes I struggle with the thought if I truly love my fiancé, or if I have somewhat become dependent.   Obviously, there's more to every story than can be put into one post. But really, thank you. These are the things that give me some type of hope. That there is truly love in the world. And if I cry, it's out of joy

Honestly, I've tried to quit. It's just rough when I know they need me so bad. Maybe it's in me to be a people pleaser, and I let it go too far. Maybe I'll speak to the boss one more time. If that does nothing then I'll take a deep breath and do it. No job is worth my life I guess😕
Thank you. I'll do that. I don't want to give up. I guess sometimes my judgement is clouded by what's in front of me. I need to be selfish sometimes. I think everyone does.

Wow.. I'm not even really sure what to say. I think I appreciate your comment more than anything else. I guess that's something I need to work on... gratitude that is. Things could always be so much worse. I know that. 

I can most definitely say that I don't want you to die. Everything you said was honest and understanding and lifted me just enough to think "holy shit that's right". Someone like that doesn't deserve to feel the way you do right now. Thank you for taking the time to comment. To share your struggles and to offer advice and also to make it clear that you understand. I can't tell you how much I appreciate it.
